display_long_description:
# Your room is the battlefield and your troopers are chickens?!

Jump into **chaotic, turn-based** warfare where bad decisions are permanent, wind can ruin the perfect shot, and that cover you trust? 
It's about to crumble! 

Fight friends, outsmart strangers, or conquer the campaign in explosive **VR** and **Mixed Reality**. 

Every shot matters. Every structure can fall. Every round plays differently.

[media]
# CASUAL MULTIPLAYER CHAOS
Battle with up to 4 players in matches that turn friendly hangouts into full-scale showdowns. Team up, settle scores, or create new rivalries!

[media]
# SKILL-BASED PHYSICS COMBAT
Angle, power, wind direction — precision wins the fight! One miscalculation can send you flying. Physics-driven gameplay rewards strategy and punishes overconfidence.

[media]
# FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENTS
Whoops, that pillar was load-bearing! Dynamic destruction reshapes the battlefield with every explosion. No position is safe forever!

# PLAY YOUR WAY:
- Up to 4-player Versus (public or private)
- Solo Campaign: 4 chapters, 18 handcrafted maps
- Challenge Mode with rewards
- Full VR or Mixed Reality
- Easy access: colorblind modes, controllers, hand tracking

Whether you execute a perfect tactical strike or accidentally destroy your own cover, no two matches unfold the same way!

Want early updates, playtests, and dev chats?
# Join the Discord: 🔗 **discord.tabletroopers.com**

See you on the battlefield, Trooper!
